selection: 4 vnc_sensory cells per rank tier for the 6 mechanosensory channels (ball_x, ball_y, ball_vx, ball_vy, paddle_x, has_laser), ranked by direct synaptic weight onto vnc_motor; 4 LC4 cells per rank tier for the 2 velocity channels (vel, vel2) and 4 LPLC2 cells per rank tier for the 2 size channels (size, size2), ranked by direct synaptic weight onto descending_neuron (no direct LC/LPLC->vnc_motor synapses exist in this data - see Ache et al. 2019, Curr. Biol. for the linear-velocity + Gaussian-size Giant Fiber looming model this split is based on); top 16 vnc_motor cells by direct weight from the chosen mechanosensory inputs; top 32 two-hop bridge cells by minimum incoming/outgoing contact strength. Ties by body ID. No game outcomes used.
assumptions: Engineered channel injection (rank tier, not named cell subtype identity). Simplified signed, normalized, leaky tanh rate units. Acetylcholine +1, GABA/glutamate -1; unknown and modulatory transmitters 0. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.
